title: AI Product Intern
description: Support discovery, prototyping and evaluation for an explainable AI product.
responsibilities: Translate user needs into testable requirements, evaluate model output and collaborate with engineers.
requirements: Python, SQL and clear product communication are required. Familiarity with LLM evaluation is preferred.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Build reproducible analyses and lightweight dashboards for a fictional operations team.
responsibilities: Clean datasets, define metrics and communicate findings with appropriate caveats.
requirements: SQL is required. Python and dashboard experience are preferred.

title: Python Backend Intern
description: Develop and test API services for a fictional workflow platform.
responsibilities: Implement endpoints, database access and automated tests; investigate production-like failures.
requirements: Python and FastAPI are required. SQL and TypeScript are beneficial.

title: AI Application Intern
description: Prototype retrieval-assisted applications and build evaluation fixtures using synthetic data.
responsibilities: Integrate model APIs, validate structured output and document failure modes.
requirements: Python is required. FastAPI, TypeScript and retrieval experience are preferred.
